company.name: RNGD
company.description:
RNGD delivers commercial, infrastructure, and industrialized construction through a fully integrated design-build model.

Our renegade mentality challenges traditional construction, enabling us to take a vertically integrated approach eliminating delays, reducing cost overruns, and ensuring certainty in schedule, quality, and execution—from day one to closeout.

Building
Our team is built for full-scope design-build delivery. We coordinate directly with owners, architects, engineers, and trade partners to streamline the entire process. Our clients benefit from a single source of accountability and a proactive team that removes roadblocks and rework before they impact the build.

Infrastructure
With every road, bridge, and public space we repair and revitalize, we know our efforts move our communities forward. More than strengthening infrastructure, we’re creating the enduring foundations that future generations will come to rely upon.

Industrialized Construction
We give our clients the advantage of more efficient, consistent and cost-effective building with our industrialized construction services. Developed by RNGD, our standalone R&D division, we offer full-service custom fabrication, prefab, manufacturing, assembly, design, and technology to build faster and better.

Prefabrication
Our prefabricated exterior wall panels redefine speed to market. Engineered and manufactured in-house, our prefab systems compress dry-in timelines from six months to just two. By integrating steel framing, sheathing, and weather barrier in a single panelized solution, we eliminate on-site coordination issues, reduce waste, and accelerate project delivery—without compromising quality or aesthetics.
